requirements.requirement: There exists a semi-autobiography whose plot centers around a body part of its protagonist.
The semi-autobiography was initially published in the author's native language.
The semi-autobiography was later translated by a translator who is another award-winning writer, translator, and journalist.
The translator received a notable translation grant at some time between 2000 and 2020, inclusive.
The author holds a PhD degree.
The author's MS dissertation earned the title of best dissertation between 2005 and 2010, inclusive.
The university where the author completed their master's degree was established on 11 August in a year between 1960 and 1990, inclusive.
The requested attribute is the real full name of the author of the semi-autobiography.
